long_biography.plain_text:
Maritime engineering sits at the centre of Dr Nicholas Andrew Hadjiyiannis's professional profile. At MIT he completed graduate work across transportation, naval architecture, marine engineering and ocean engineering, culminating in a mechanical-engineering doctorate. His research examined iron-ore transportation in capesize bulk carriers, connecting technical study with the commercial structure of shipping.

Hadjiyiannis moved into full-time professional work at Cyprus Maritime after completing his studies. In public shipping forums, he has examined how charter length affects investment in lower-emission vessel technology. His executive-committee work at Intercargo places that operating perspective within an international dry-cargo industry body.
